title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E01 — Red Ball
McCoy and Borgia consider making a deal with an ex-convict in order to save an abducted five-year-old girl.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E02 — Flaw
Fontana and Green seek the aid of Detective Olivia Benson; they discover a money-laundering scheme involving a mother-daughter team Benson had dealt with in a past case.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E03 — Ghosts
A criminal makes a startling deathbed confession; Detective Fontana reopens a 10-year-old case file concerning the murder of a 12-year-old girl.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E07 — Boom-Boom-Boom-Boom
Following a natural gas explosion at a movie theater, the team discovers the gas company has been hacked, and more explosions could be triggered.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E08 — The Order of the Mongoose
Sebastian calls the team to assist with a possible kidnapping case when a dignitary's son he was assigned to protect disappears from a local concert venue.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E18 — Slay the Dragon
Tammy is reunited with her ex-husband, Ethan McKinley - who embezzled millions in Katrina relief funds - after he's tied to the murder of a crime boss' son.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E18 — In Plain Sight
The NCIS team investigates the murder of Patton's friend, a former Navy SEAL gunned down in a drive-by shooting while Patton watched.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E13 — Sound Off
After a body is found at an unmanned aerial vehicle testing site, the NCIS team must determine if the death was murder or an accident; Palmer carefully interviews medical examiner assistant candidates.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E15 — Lonely Hearts
The lead suspect in a murder investigation is a woman that Gibbs' friend met on a dating site; Sloane has a secret admirer on Valentine's Day.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E16 — Ephemera
The team tries to piece together how a retired Navy officer obtained a rare and valuable coin.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E18 — Schooled
The body of a well-regarded Navy technician is found floating in a lake, which isn't far from where a popular community event takes place; Sloane's daughter makes an unexpected request.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E17 — In a Nutshell
A Navy officer is murdered the same way his parents were murdered a decade ago; the team stumbles across a storage container filled with dollhouses that display re-creations of murder scenes; the team members agree to clean out their living spaces.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E20 — The Arizona
The team tries to verify the identity of Joe Smith, who claims he served on the U.S.S. Arizona during the attack on Pearl Harbor and wants to be buried there upon his death.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E19 — Blarney
When Kasie and Jimmy are held hostage in a diner after a jewelry store robbery goes awry, they attempt to keep the other customers safe from the thieves.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E08 — True Believer
When Sloane's name is discovered in Afghanistan at the site of an abandoned bus with a dead driver, Gibbs accompanies her on a trip to find a group of girls who were kidnapped from the bus; a hacker emails compromising information to the Taliban.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E06 — 1mm
Following a tip about smuggled weapons, Bishop and Torres engage in a shootout in a former sheriff's residence that's now a historical site, only to find themselves locked in abandoned jail cells there.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E14 — Trigger Effect
While investigating a mass casualty incident at a New York City restaurant, the team scrambles to determine if it was racially motivated and if there was more than one gunman; Maggie starts to notice troubling behavior from her co-worker Elise.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E15 — Straight Flush
When five prominent men are gunned down at a trendy New York restaurant, the team's investigation brings them into contact with a lieutenant in Antonio Vargas' cartel, triggering a showdown between Isobel and Vargas.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E01 — All That Glitters
After a young woman is killed on her way home from a lavish yacht party, the team investigates who she was and how she came to be at the event.

title: Colombiana
description: In 1992 Bogotá, a little girl watches crime lord Don Luis and his henchman Marco murder her parents. Fifteen years later, the now-grown Cataleya, who is named for a Colombian orchid, works as a contract killer for her Chicago-based uncle.

title: Enough
description: After running away fails, a terrified woman (Jennifer Lopez) empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband (Billy Campbell).

description: After running away fails, a terrified woman (Jennifer Lopez) empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband (Billy Campbell).

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

After Eddie Barrett provides an alibi witness, Pride and the team are more determined than ever to find a break in the case and avenge LaSalle's murder.

description:
S06 E10 — Requital
Pride is cut off from the team and backed into a corner after the investigation into Eddie Barrett uncovers a malicious plot.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

The team is concerned when Sebastian becomes unreachable while undercover as a new recruit.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E12 — Waiting for Monroe
The team must track down a mysterious female assassin responsible for murders in Athens, Rome and London; Wade's son begs her to allow him to go on a police ride-along for an article he's writing on a youth outreach program.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E13 — The Root of All Evil
The team investigates the murder of a JAG captain who was discovered at home by his daughter, the only heir to his large estate; Sebastian is intimidated when he is put in charge of a team on his first day of training.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E14 — The Man in the Red Suit
When Pride is unable to sleep due to continuing nightmares about the mysterious man in the red suit; he undergoes a specialized treatment to help him figure out the man's identity; an arrogant new officer joins the team.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E07 — The First Day
NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer who was killed while driving home a recently released inmate; Gibbs helps Palmer deal with a personal trauma.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E09 — Winter Chill
NCIS dives into the competitive world of food trucks after finding a man frozen to death in the back of one.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E10 — Watchdog
The team uncovers a secret dogfighting ring, which leads to an unexpected move by one of the team members.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E14 — Unseen Improvements
NCIS tracks a stolen laptop to the uncle of a young boy, Phineas, Gibbs' former neighbor.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E15 — Blown Away
When members of an NCIS Regional Enforcement Action Capabilities Training Team are killed during an explosion, NCIS Special Agent Jessica Knight, the lone surviving member, helps crack the case using high-tech body armor.

title: NCIS
description:

The investigation into a petty officer's murder leads the team to its prime suspect: Director Vance's brother-in-law.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E20 — The Missionary Position
Tony helps Ziva and her mentor look for a missing Marine lieutenant in Colombia; Jimmy Palmer chooses his best man.

title: NCIS
description:

The team works with the Baltimore police to investigate a warehouse fire that revealed missing Navy documents that could potentially threaten national security; Tony reunites with a boy from his past.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E22 — Playing With Fire
An investigation into a fire on a Navy vessel leads to a discovery that elevates security at Navy facilities worldwide; Ziva and DiNozzo are called in when an explosive device is found on a ship in Italy.

title: NCIS
description:

As the team searches for a terrorist targeting the Navy, a bug is found in a probationary agent's tooth; Jimmy Palmer has a bachelor party.

title: NCIS
description:

Shaken by terrorism, the NCIS faces devastating surprises; the case impacts Jimmy Palmer's destination wedding.

title: NCIS
description:

Ducky orders the exhumation of a body from a 12-year-old case; the team investigates a Marine's death.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The BAU team flies to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes, with surveillance video from a park as their only lead to finding the children's whereabouts.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E09 — Broken Wing
A professor from Lewis' past tips off the BAU to an alarming number of overdose deaths of patients who just completed rehab.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

When Reid and Garcia are abducted by a mass murderer, it's up to the rest of the team to find them; the BAU looks to their past to solve why the two heroes have been targeted.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E14 — Sick and Evil
The BAU investigates a string of murders taking place in supposedly haunted houses in Lewiston, Maine.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E03 — Spectator Slowing
The BAU team investigates a series of seemingly random fatal explosions throughout Kentucky and Tennessee.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E06 — Date Night
After a father and daughter get kidnapped, a former foe of the BAU returns with very specific demands for Dr. Reid.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E07 — Rusty
When the BAU team travels to Denver to investigate several murders, Prentiss is forced to evaluate her relationship with Special Agent Andrew Mendoza.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E15 — Relentless
Tammy must protect a teenage girl after her father is shot in their home; the rest of the team searches for a motive.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E16 — Pride and Prejudice
When a man impersonating LaSalle attempts to free a young woman from jail, the team investigates both the impostor and the prisoner; Pride's daughter pays him a surprise visit.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E17 — Biased
Racial tensions rise in New Orleans when a white officer shoots a black Navy officer he believed was armed in the middle of a busy street party.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E09 — Into Thin Air
Pride and the team are on the hunt for a kidnapped 14-year-old and discover that her father, who will soon have custody of her, is a radical survivalist living off the grid.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E10 — Tick Tock
Pride is given a series of tasks to complete by unknown assailants who are holding Wade and his father hostage.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E18 — A Changed Woman
When a Navy sailor is found dead, the team tracks the suspicious movements of people in his life prior to his death; Hannah comes to terms with her daughter's relationship with her ex's new girlfriend.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S06 E19 — Monolith
When Sebastian is injured while unsuccessfully trying to prevent a kidnapping, NCIS races to find the missing woman and her abductors; the team gets a peek into Agent Carter's personal life.

title: Law & Order
description:

Detectives investigate when a man is killed by a car bomb before he can disconnect his incapacitated wife's feeding tube.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E19 — Fallout
The death of a Russian émigré (Michael Aronov) seems to be an act of terrorism until the medical examiner finds traces of a specific drug in the victim's body.

description:

An 8-year-old girl dies in the explosion of an Upper East Side brownstone; detectives determine faulty wiring is to blame, but with little evidence it is difficult to prove the case.

title: Law & Order
description:

A young Middle Eastern man dies in an apparent hate-crime, but the suspect hires a high-powered lawyer who tries to have the case thrown out.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E05 — Public Service Homicide
A man (A.J. Handegard) dies after being identified on a newsmagazine program that had been luring suspected pedophiles by having staff members pose as young girls.

title: Law & Order
description:

An executive of a body armor company is gunned down while arriving at his daughter's $2 million sweet-16 party; detectives tie the incident to a U.S. soldier killed in Iraq when his vest failed.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E11 — Bible Story
Religious tempers flare when a man is killed after desecrating a treasured edition of the Hebrew Torah.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E12 — Family Friend
An officer exacts revenge upon his friend's alleged killer and tries to avoid prosecution by threatening to expose tainted evidence from previous cases.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E13 — Heart of Darkness
Though a journalist's death in a bathtub looks like suicide, hand marks on his shoulders and pills from an ex's prescription suggest foul play.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E14 — Magnet
A promising Hispanic student at a specialist school is strangled; Fontana and Green soon learn the victim was selling test answers and writing papers for more privileged students.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E15 — Choice of Evils
A woman says she killed her teenage son out of fear that he would follow in his criminal father's footsteps.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E08 — Release
Chris Drake finds his friend dead on a party bus, making him an instant suspect; as investigators dig deeper into the case, more of the story comes to light, leading to an unlikely conviction.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E09 — Deadlock
When a convicted mass murderer escapes from prison, detectives rush to apprehend him, but not before he murders two more people.

title: Law & Order
description:
S16 E22 — Invaders
McCoy risks his career when he uses a corrupt DEA agent (Ritchie Coster) to lure psychopathic killers out of hiding.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E15 — Melting Pot
When an actress is found hanging in her office, detectives quickly discover that she suffered a blow to the head prior to the hanging.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E16 — Murder Book
A high-profile publisher is found dead after putting out a controversial book.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E17 — Good Faith
Green and Cassady suspect arson in a string of church fires, but the discovery of a body in the ruins shifts the focus of the investigation to homicide.

title: Law & Order
description:
S17 E18 — Bling
Detectives determine to find out whether a rapper's murder was a random act or connected to her work.

title: FBI
description:

Maggie, OA and the team must stop a hacker who is disabling life-saving equipment in several New York City hospitals; Jubal's son waits for important surgery at one of the impacted hospitals.

title: FBI
description:

The team finds a connection between bombings and a private veterans' club in New York City; Isobel tells a reluctant OA to recruit a former Army buddy for intel.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E04 — Know Thyself
The team hunts for a serial killer who is targeting young, homeless men; Tiffany and Scola don't see eye to eye on how to handle the case.

title: FBI
description:

After a suburban woman is kidnapped from her home, the team looks into trysts on both sides of a seemingly perfect marriage; OA feels pressure from Mona to make changes in his career path.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E06 — Allegiance
The team must track down a shooter targeting detectives from the same precinct and unit while facing mounting tension from the NYPD; Tiffany finds that her NYPD roots may be influencing her view of the situation.

title: FBI
description:

After a young girl is kidnapped from her daycare, the team must help her parents navigate a debt owed to the deadly gang in their neighborhood; Maggie struggles to focus on the case when her sister returns from rehab.
